Inclusion Criteria for chronic periodontitis groups:
  -  Clinical attachment loss ≥ 5mm
  -  Probing depth ≥5mm
  -  Bone loss affecting >30% of the existing teeth on clinical  [OR] and radiographic examination
  -  gingival index (GI) score> 1
Inclusion criteria for control group:
  -  full-mouth PD was≤ 3mm,
  -  Gingival index <1
  -  there was no  [OR] indication of Attachment Loss or no radiographic evidence of alveolar bone loss in control group

Smoking criteria for groups:
  -  patients smoked more than 10 cigarettes in a day
  -  smoking for 3 or more years,
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  systemic condition (diabetes, [OR]  cardiovascular disease, [OR]  immunologic disorders, [OR]  hepatitis, e
